title: The Normal Form of Smith's Matrices
summary: For any integers $x$ and $y$, let $(x,y)$ and $[x,y]$ stand for the greatest common divisor and the least common multiple of $x$ and $y$, respectively. We denote by $|T|$ the number of elements of a finite set $T$. Let $a,b$ and $n$ be positive integers and let $S=\{x_1,...,x_n\}$ be a set of $n$ distinct positive integers. Let $(f((x_i,x_j)))$ (abbreviated by $f(S)$) and $(f([x_i,x_j]))$ (abbreviated by $(f([S]))$) stand for the $n\times n$ matrices whose $(i,j)-$entry is $(f((x_i,x_j)))$ and $(f([x_i,x_j]))$ respectively.
